desc: Prove/verify the factorization: per-prime independent sign choices; walk exponents; gcd condition = per-prime min exponent 0; answer = ∏_p W_p.
Design per-prime DP over relative height with incremental weight p^{h'} on normal steps and p^{i·(e−h)} on underflow (min-drop boost of i previous positions). Verified on Sample 2 by hand (18 ✓).
Combine results over primes; primes not dividing any A_i contribute factor 1.
Implement solution with numpy-vectorized transitions, precomputed power table pw per prime (length max(H, (N−1)·max_e)+1), int64 arithmetic safe against overflow (products < 10^18).
Verify against Samples 1–3 and edge cases (all A_i=1, N=2, adversarial A_i=512 for max p=2 height); check performance worst case (~10^7 numpy element-ops total).
